summary_1line: Tormented by misfortune and Kali’s influence, Nala secretly cuts their shared cloth and abandons the sleeping Damayanti in the forest.

image_candidates.scene_text: In a dim forest shelter, Nala cuts half of the single garment he shares with the sleeping Damayanti using a найден sword.
Nala stands weeping over Damayanti as she sleeps on the bare earth, clad in a torn cloth inside a lonely forest hut.
Torn between love and fate, Nala repeatedly walks away from the hut and returns, as if pulled back by an invisible force in the dark forest night.
